name: The Western Watch
label: Quest
description: The Western Watch: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.
Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, it's clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
